practice-arc.prompt: wind that begins as a faint whisper and grows steadily into a howling storm, clear build from quiet to loud

practice-steady.prompt: wind blowing at a constant moderate strength, steady and unchanging throughout

pulses-arc.prompt: scattered ticking pulses at slightly different rates that gradually pull together and lock into one shared rhythm, clear arc from chaos to order

pulses-steady.prompt: scattered ticking pulses at slightly different rates, steady texture, unchanging throughout

pad-arc.prompt: warm synthesizer pad that starts almost silent, slowly swells to a full bright climax, then fades away

pad-steady.prompt: warm synthesizer pad held at a constant level, static and unchanging

rain-arc.prompt: rain that begins as a few scattered drops and builds into a heavy downpour

rain-steady.prompt: steady rain at a constant even intensity

drone-arc.prompt: low dark drone that slowly brightens and rises into high shimmering tones

drone-steady.prompt: low dark drone, static, no change

long.prompt: ambient pad that slowly evolves over a minute, starting dark and low, opening into bright airy tones by the end
